title: IoT-based real-time water quality monitoring system
abstract_one_line: Deployed ESP8266-based IoT nodes for pH, turbidity, and temperature monitoring in water distribution; achieved 94.7% alert accuracy with cloud dashboard visualization.
relevance_to_aquent: Benchmark untuk arsitektur sensor IoT air dan presisi alert system. Dikutip sebagai gap G01 — hanya 3 parameter, belum ada komponen kesehatan kulit.
key_finding: 94.7% alert accuracy, real-time cloud dashboard
aquent_citation_context: Benchmark sensor hardware (P2); justifikasi gap G01 — hanya 3 parameter

title: Efficient water quality prediction using supervised machine learning
abstract_one_line: Compared ANN, SVM, and Random Forest for multi-parameter water quality prediction; Random Forest achieved R²=0.94 across pH, TDS, turbidity, and temperature.
relevance_to_aquent: Validasi pendekatan ML untuk prediksi kualitas air — mendukung desain algoritma scoring P2.
methodology: Machine learning comparative study (ANN, SVM, RF)
key_finding: Random Forest R²=0.94 for water quality prediction
aquent_citation_context: Validasi ML untuk F09 History analytics dan F08 Scheduler

title: Quantitative assessment of water hardness and atopic dermatitis: a systematic review and meta-analysis
abstract_one_line: Meta-analysis of 14 studies confirmed statistically significant association between residential water hardness (TDS) and increased atopic dermatitis prevalence in children (OR 1.87, 95% CI 1.30–2.68).
relevance_to_aquent: KUNCI — justifikasi threshold TDS dan dampak air keras pada kulit. Dikutip di thresholds.json, encyclopedia.json (dermatitis atopik), dermal-guide.json, xai-explanation.md, ai-chat-system.md.
key_finding: OR 1.87 (95% CI 1.30–2.68) untuk atopic dermatitis di area air keras
aquent_citation_context: Threshold TDS >300ppm, alert TDS_high, encyclopedia Dermatitis Atopik, badge Skin Guardian

title: Chlorine in tap water and its effects on skin barrier function
abstract_one_line: In vitro and clinical study demonstrating that free chlorine >0.5 mg/L significantly reduces ceramide levels and increases TEWL, particularly in atopic skin.
relevance_to_aquent: Justifikasi threshold klorin ≤0.5 mg/L dan alasan filter karbon aktif direkomendasikan. Dikutip di thresholds.json, xai-explanation.md, shower_myths.json.
key_finding: Chlorine >0.5 mg/L reduces ceramide and increases TEWL in atopic skin
aquent_citation_context: Threshold chlorine 0.5 mg/L, alert_chlorine_high, rekomendasi filter karbon aktif

title: Smart home IoT water management with cloud analytics
abstract_one_line: Proposed smart home water management integrating pH, TDS, and temperature IoT sensors with ML-based anomaly detection, achieving 89% alert precision; lacks skin health context.
relevance_to_aquent: Referensi untuk smart home IoT architecture. Dikutip sebagai gap G02 — tidak ada histori jangka panjang; gap G08 — tidak ada loop kontrol berbasis kualitas.
methodology: IoT system deployment + ML anomaly detection
key_finding: 89% alert precision, smart home IoT architecture
aquent_citation_context: F09 History Analytics, F07 Smart Control panel design

title: Natural skin surface pH is on average below 5, which is beneficial for its resident flora
abstract_one_line: Landmark clinical study (n=128) establishing that healthy skin surface pH is 4.1–5.8, and alkaline water exposure disrupts this barrier with consequential effects on skin microbiome.
relevance_to_aquent: KUNCI — justifikasi threshold pH dan pemilihan sabun pH-balanced. Dikutip di thresholds.json, xai-explanation.md (semua pH variants), dermal-guide.json, shower_myths.json.
methodology: Clinical study (n=128) skin surface pH measurement
key_finding: Healthy skin pH 4.1–5.8; alkaline water disrupts acid mantle and microbiome
aquent_citation_context: Threshold pH 6.5–8.5, alert_ph_high, XAI explanation pH variants, produk Sebamed pH 5.5

title: Deep learning for water quality anomaly detection in distribution networks
abstract_one_line: LSTM-based deep learning framework for real-time anomaly detection across 5 water quality parameters in two city distribution networks, achieving F1-score of 0.91.
relevance_to_aquent: Referensi untuk anomaly detection dalam sistem 5-parameter. Mendukung desain History Analytics (F09).
key_finding: F1-score 0.91 for 5-parameter anomaly detection
aquent_citation_context: Validasi pendekatan 5-parameter; F09 History & trend analysis

title: Firebase-based real-time IoT health monitoring
abstract_one_line: Demonstrated Firebase Realtime Database as viable backend for IoT health monitoring with latency <200ms; foundational reference for AQUENT Firebase architecture.
relevance_to_aquent: Validasi Firebase Realtime Database sebagai backend IoT — arsitektur inti AQUENT.
key_finding: Firebase latency <200ms, viable for real-time health IoT
aquent_citation_context: Firebase architecture decision; functions/index.js design

title: A survey on explainable artificial intelligence (XAI): Toward medical XAI
journal: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
abstract_one_line: Comprehensive survey of 140 XAI methods for medical applications, concluding that factor attribution with confidence scoring significantly increases clinician trust and system adoption.
relevance_to_aquent: KUNCI untuk desain XAI — justifikasi factor attribution bars dan confidence score. Dikutip di Novelty N01, gap G03, TAM hypothesis H5.
key_finding: Factor attribution + confidence scoring meningkatkan kepercayaan dan adopsi di medical AI
aquent_citation_context: F02 XAI Panel design, confidence score, xai-explanation.md, XAIT construct di QUESTIONNAIRE.md

title: Design and deployment of low-cost sensors for monitoring water quality in distribution systems
abstract_one_line: Validated low-cost turbidity sensor (nephelometer-based) achieving <5% error at 0–10 NTU range; established turbidity <1 NTU as key threshold for safe water contact.
relevance_to_aquent: Justifikasi threshold turbidity 1 NTU dan desain sensor turbidity low-cost. Dikutip di filter_guide.json (sediment filter dan activated carbon).
key_finding: <5% error at 0–10 NTU, turbidity <1 NTU threshold for safe contact
aquent_citation_context: Threshold turbidity 1 NTU, alert_turbidity_high, filter_guide.json sediment filter

title: The role of filaggrin in atopic dermatitis: a systematic review and perspectives
journal: Journal of the European Academy of Dermatology and Venereology
abstract_one_line: Cross-sectional study (n=4,532) demonstrating hard water exposure correlates with psoriasis severity, with filaggrin degradation as the primary mechanistic pathway.
relevance_to_aquent: Mekanisme filaggrin — menjelaskan mengapa TDS tinggi merusak skin barrier. Mendukung ensiklopedia entri Dermatitis Atopik dan Psoriasis.
key_finding: Hard water degrades filaggrin → impaired skin barrier → atopic dermatitis
aquent_citation_context: encyclopedia.json Dermatitis Atopik + Psoriasis scientific_basis, products.json Physiogel

title: Multi-parameter water quality monitoring sensor node for IoT applications
abstract_one_line: Designed ESP32-based 4-parameter sensor node (pH, temp, turbidity, TDS) with calibration accuracy within 3% RMSE; benchmark reference for AQUENT hardware specifications.
relevance_to_aquent: Benchmark hardware untuk sensor node AQUENT. Dikutip sebagai gap G01 — 4 parameter, belum ada klorin dan konteks kulit.
key_finding: 4-parameter ESP32 sensor node, 3% RMSE accuracy
aquent_citation_context: Hardware reference untuk sensor node AQUENT; gap G01 justification

title: A unified approach to interpreting model predictions (SHAP)
abstract_one_line: Introduced SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) as a unified framework for model-agnostic feature attribution, the theoretical foundation for AQUENT's XAI factor contribution system.
relevance_to_aquent: Landasan teori untuk desain XAI factor attribution bars di AQUENT. AQUENT mengimplementasikan konsep SHAP melalui rule-based weight attribution, bukan SHAP ML klasik.
key_finding: SHAP: unified model-agnostic feature attribution framework
aquent_citation_context: Theoretical basis XAI Panel (F02); N01 Novelty claim justifikasi

title: European guideline (EuroGuiDerm) on atopic eczema: part I and II
journal: Journal of the European Academy of Dermatology and Venereology
abstract_one_line: European Delphi consensus guideline recommending lukewarm water (36–38°C), max 10-min showers, and immediate emollient application for atopic eczema — primary basis for AQUENT temperature thresholds.
relevance_to_aquent: KUNCI — sumber utama threshold suhu 36–38°C dan rekomendasi durasi mandi. Dikutip di thresholds.json, dermal-guide.json, xai-explanation.md, shower_myths.json.
key_finding: Lukewarm 36–38°C, max 10 min, immediate emollient — clinical guideline for atopic eczema
aquent_citation_context: Threshold suhu optimal 36–38°C, alert_temp_high, badge Temperature Pro, shower_myths

title: Large language models for patient education and health engagement: a systematic review
abstract_one_line: RCT (n=312) demonstrating LLM-powered chatbots increased patient health self-monitoring adherence by 41% compared to static content; validates AQUENT's AI Chat approach for skin health engagement.
relevance_to_aquent: KUNCI untuk validasi AI Chat feature. Justifikasi penggunaan Gemini sebagai AI Skin Consultant dan efektivitasnya untuk perubahan perilaku.
key_finding: +41% adherence to health self-monitoring with LLM chatbot vs static content
aquent_citation_context: F02 AI Chat justification, Novelty N01, badge AI Partner, BCI construct

title: Design and implementation of a thermostatic smart shower system with IoT integration
abstract_one_line: Smart shower system with temperature-only IoT control achieving ±0.5°C precision; confirmed skin-friendly temperature is user-configurable — but lacked quality sensor integration beyond temperature.
relevance_to_aquent: Referensi terdekat dengan konsep AQUENT — smart shower IoT. Dikutip sebagai gap G08 — tidak ada loop kontrol berdasarkan kualitas sensor lengkap.
key_finding: ±0.5°C temperature precision, user-configurable shower IoT
aquent_citation_context: F07 Smart Control reference; gap G08 justification; F05 Eco-Monitor

title: Cloud-based IoT for real-time public water quality surveillance
journal: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health
abstract_one_line: 6-month deployment of cloud IoT water quality monitoring at 18 public sites; demonstrated real-time alert systems for chlorine and turbidity, but no skin health personalization layer.
relevance_to_aquent: Referensi untuk cloud IoT water monitoring scale-up. Dikutip sebagai gap G06 — tidak ada integrasi sustainability.
key_finding: Real-time alert for chlorine + turbidity at 18 public sites; no skin personalization
aquent_citation_context: F05 Eco-Monitor; F10 Smart Alert; gap G06 justification

title: Disparities in dermatology AI performance on a diverse, curated clinical image set
abstract_one_line: Evaluated dermatology AI (CNN) on 16,954 diverse skin images; identified performance gaps in darker skin tones, supporting AQUENT's need for XAI transparency in skin health AI tools.
relevance_to_aquent: Justifikasi kebutuhan XAI di Skin Scanner — AI kulit tidak sempurna, transparansi penting. Badge First Scan mengutip studi ini.
key_finding: Dermatology AI has performance gaps on darker skin tones; XAI transparency is critical
aquent_citation_context: F04 Skin Scanner XAI disclaimer; badges.json First Scan; Novelty N02

title: Association between domestic water hardness, chlorine, and atopic dermatitis risk in early life
abstract_one_line: Longitudinal cohort (n=2,871 infants) demonstrating that residential water hardness ≥250 ppm and chlorine ≥0.5 mg/L independently increase atopic dermatitis risk by 44% and 28% respectively.
relevance_to_aquent: KUNCI — data kuantitatif dampak TDS dan klorin secara independen pada kulit bayi. Dikutip di thresholds.json, shower_myths.json, filter_guide.json (ion exchange softener).
key_finding: Water hardness ≥250 ppm: +44% AD risk; Chlorine ≥0.5 mg/L: +28% AD risk (independent)
aquent_citation_context: Threshold TDS dan klorin; filter_guide.json ion exchange; encyclopedia Dermatitis Atopik

title: Digital twin approaches for real-time water quality prediction in urban distribution systems
abstract_one_line: Digital twin framework for real-time water quality prediction in distribution networks using multi-sensor fusion; demonstrated predictive scheduling potential relevant to AQUENT's shower scheduler feature.
relevance_to_aquent: Referensi untuk predictive analytics kualitas air — mendukung desain AI Scheduler (F08).
key_finding: Digital twin predicts water quality changes 2 hours ahead with 87% accuracy
aquent_citation_context: F08 AI Shower Scheduler; gap G09 justification

title: Privacy, trust and transparency barriers to consumer IoT health monitoring adoption
abstract_one_line: Survey (n=847) and qualitative interviews revealing that 61% distrust IoT health data handling; system transparency and explainability increased user adoption intent by 34%, validating AQUENT's XAI and demo mode design.
relevance_to_aquent: KUNCI untuk desain UX dan kepercayaan — justifikasi Demo Mode, transparent XAI, dan IDPT construct di QUESTIONNAIRE.md. Dikutip di PLANNING_PROGRAMMER.md dan slr.html.
key_finding: 61% distrust IoT health data; transparency increases adoption by 34%
aquent_citation_context: Demo Mode design; IDPT construct QUESTIONNAIRE.md; Novelty N01; gap G10; PLANNING_PROGRAMMER P14
